description: A hospital hires ultrasound technicians and graduate researchers to image patients. An ultrasound technician works 8 hours per shift while a graduate researcher works 5 hours per shift. Ultrasound technicians are paid $300 per shift while graduate researchers are paid $100 per shift. However, due to regulations, there must be twice as many ultrasound technician shifts than graduate researcher shifts. Currently, the hospital needs 500 hours of ultrasound services to meet needs. If the hospital has a budget of $14000, how many of each worker certified to use the ultrasound should be scheduled to reduce the total number of workers?

UltrasoundTechnicianShiftHours.definition: The number of hours an ultrasound technician works per shift

GraduateResearcherShiftHours.definition: The number of hours a graduate researcher works per shift

UltrasoundTechnicianPayment.definition: The payment an ultrasound technician receives per shift

GraduateResearcherPayment.definition: The payment a graduate researcher receives per shift

ShiftRatio.definition: The required ratio of ultrasound technician shifts to graduate researcher shifts

RequiredUltrasoundServiceHours.definition: The total number of ultrasound service hours required

TotalBudget.definition: The total budget available for workers' payments

objective.description: Minimize the total number of workers (ultrasound technicians and graduate researchers) scheduled

constraints.description: 8 times the number of ultrasound technician shifts plus 5 times the number of graduate researcher shifts must be greater than or equal to 500
300 times the number of ultrasound technician shifts plus 100 times the number of graduate researcher shifts must be less than or equal to 14000
The number of ultrasound technician shifts must be equal to 2 times the number of graduate researcher shifts
The number of ultrasound technician shifts must be non-negative
The number of graduate researcher shifts must be non-negative
The number of ultrasound technician shifts must be an integer
The number of graduate researcher shifts must be an integer

UltrasoundTechnicianShifts.definition: The number of ultrasound technician shifts scheduled

GraduateResearcherShifts.definition: The number of graduate researcher shifts scheduled
